season.evidence: Searched: trail to the lookout has avalanche chutes crossed under the summit; snow remains on upper slopes through June and returns by late November; extreme avalanche danger warnings late fall to late spring. Snow-free roughly July to October.

otherTracksConsidered.why: May 2: standard-line start at the trailhead and highest point at the lookout side, but snowbound season.
June 25; summit is the west peak (Tusk O Granite) from a different start.

notes: WRONG PEAK MATCH: the Peakbagger peak matched to this area is Tusk O Granite (West Granite Mountain, 47.4236,-121.4920), not the lookout summit; four of five tracks end there, only 3183575 reaches the lookout summit region (47.4176,-121.4815, 1,039 m away). Our area coordinate is 329 m from Tusk, so the area pin may be on the wrong summit. Standard-scramble route has no waypoints. Tracks are out of season for a summer trail, so none assigned.
